course_name: 永磁同步電動機之理論與控制
outline: The objective of this course is to teach control theory of permanent magnet ac motors. The main contents are: 1)BLDC design, drive, and control, 2)PMSM motor modeling, 3)vector control, maximum torque control, and field weakening, 4) Current control and PWM inverter, 5) initial position sensing and sensorless control.
schedule:
1. PM and magnetic circuit
2. BLDC basics
3. stator design
4. rotor design
5. motor design variations
6. drive and control
7. drive and control
8. mid-term exam.
9. PMSM basics
10. complex vector model
11. vector control
12. maximum torque control
13. current control
14. PWM drive
15. field weakening
16. initial position sensing
17. sensorless vector control
18. final exam.
